content.text: I do not want you to make any code changes just suggest a plan. This cli contains a deploy command with a number of sub-commands related to deployments. I would like to introduce a special environment with the sole purpose of verifying the gitops manifests. It should run in a local k3s cluster. It needs to run dependencies like dapr and kgateway but the deployments will be done using the api directly. We should value speed in setting everything up
